title: Remember Better: - Listen and Repeat: Say Key Points Aloud After Hearing Them
description: To remember better: - Listen and repeat: Say key points aloud after hearing them. - Mix modalities: Write down spoken info or speak aloud written notes. - Review audio: Record important notes and listen back later. Example: After a meeting, record a summary of key points and listen to it during your commute.
